name: What is the process for sliding door glass replacement with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for sliding door glass replacement with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation and measurement of your existing sliding door glass. We then provide a detailed quote based on your chosen glass type and specifications. Once approved, we order the new glass unit. Upon arrival, our skilled technicians will carefully remove the damaged glass, prepare the frame, and expertly install the new glass panel, ensuring a precise fit and proper sealing. We conclude with a final inspection and clean-up.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process includes consultation, measurement, quoting, ordering glass, professional installation, and a final inspection. We handle everything from start to finish.
